noninferiority.hypotheses: H0: mean(student utility - teacher utility) <= -margin; H1: mean > -margin
noninferiority.limitations: One-sided normal approximation using sample SD of independent block means; not an exact, distribution-free, sequential, or multiple-testing-adjusted guarantee. Requires a frozen candidate/panel and fresh confirmation blocks at a predeclared fixed count. Failure to demonstrate non-inferiority does not establish inferiority.

scope: One unchanged fixed candidate/panel, fresh fixed 319-block normal-approximation test; local heuristic retention only.
